parallel_task.title: Add IAM research pilot login
parallel_task.coordination: Other task deployed and released the staging lane first; reflection changes rebased before deployment.

checks: Origin, CSRF, researcher authentication and staging-only preview enforced
Production-host regression: existing pilot unlocks once, valid password reaches consent and Heart Check, passwords and ten-person cap remain enforced
New studies and explicit organiser pauses stay closed; no verification, contact, review or retention values are fabricated
Existing website password opens the portal directly; staging remains isolated and return identity survives session expiry
Before/after state machine, 1–10 bounds, idempotency, missing vitals and isolated preview completion
One answer per step persists in order; 10-second scan accepted; PSD stays unavailable; participant cannot choose event window
Versioned reflection follows baseline, validates choices, persists through reload/retry and changes no measurements or exposure
Researcher operations require owner session; preview records never enter cohort; enrolment readiness enforced
Participant and stakeholder codes have separate scopes; no cross-participant or raw stakeholder access
Reward QR resolves only for owner; private claim and pass authentication stay private; no shared-wallet issuance
Only $100 after all three sessions; no partial or duplicate payments
On-demand session starts with no event date; incomplete and already-paid rewards cannot be redeemed
Shared website password creates separate cohort identities per browser and resumes only its own records
Production completion clock race reproduced and recovered by retry; lost response acknowledged idempotently; preview skip rejected in production
Actual media-ended duration advances to after-check; no premature transition or invented exposure after a missing heartbeat
Replaced media starts a fresh clock without carrying old duration or discarding prior exposure history
Withdrawal removes requested response fields and invalidates derived results

Dedicated ending test is staging-only, uses a separate cookie/store, has no fabricated baseline, requires real end plus 30-second clock, completes ordinary after flow, and leaves cohort and participant unchanged
Dedicated test HTML is available on staging and returns 404 on the production host
